title: Original 1955 Duncan Green Super Tournament Yo-Yo & Trick Book
descriptionText: The Original 1955 Duncan Green Super Tournament Yo-Yo is a classic toy that is still sought after by collectors and enthusiasts. Made by the renowned brand Duncan, this yo-yo is known for its quality and durability. The trick book included offers a variety of fun and challenging tricks to perform, making it a great toy for both play and showmanship. Perfect for anyone looking to add a nostalgic touch to their collection or to learn new yo-yo tricks.
